name: Stormwrought Ruins
_map: Turtle instance map 818 (5-man dungeon under Stormwrought Castle). Map 818 is unused in 3.3.5.
_extra_creature_templates: Summoned by the bosses (Nether Imp, Mergothid, Eldermaw Crocolisk, Growth of Mycellakos, Enraged Sea Elemental).

instance._min_level: Turtle requires 35; lowered to 30 on the server owner's request.
instance._graveyard: Where players are sent when they release inside the instance: Turtle's front-exit teleport target (areatrigger_teleport 5348). Always {map,x,y,z,o}.

notes: Stormwrought Castle Gates (2 doors opened with the Key to Stormwrought Castle or lockpicking) use a Turtle lock that the 3.3.5 client does not have; they are left out, so those passages are open.
_force_display: Turtle-made models: Deathlord Tidebane -> Death Knight Darkreaver (mounted death knight), Remains of the Innocent -> crimson ooze.
